messages:
Sam: Morning all — quick async standup for the provisioning window. Short snapshot: what I did / blockers / today. Main focus: fleet capacity for the EU prewarm and cloud region fallbacks.

Alex: Ran the capacity calc overnight. AMS is at ~92/96 CPU cores used for GPU nodepools. For the prewarm window I need +4 g5 nodes (prefer 2 on-demand, 2 spot fallback). Opened INFRA-492 for quota request.

Maria: Noted — support case 882234 is in for an AMS cores increase. If that doesn't land we should redistribute. Can we move 2 prewarm nodes to IAD as a temporary measure? :thinking_face:

Sam: Yes — plan: shift 2 -> IAD (spot), keep 2 -> AMS on-demand. Latency impact should be minimal for background batch jobs. @Chen can you update the prewarm policy?

Chen: On it. Current var is `prewarm_desired = 6`. I'll bump to 10 for the window. Command I'm about to run:
```
terraform apply -var='prewarm_desired=10' -target=module.prewarm
```
Applying in ~10m and will post results.

provision-bot: Scheduled: terraform plan complete, apply queued by Chen at 2026-03-17T03:10:00Z.

Alex: FYI saw a KV-cache miss spike yesterday around 01:20 UTC causing a longer tail on p95. If we add these nodes without increasing cache memory we might still see some latency. Suggest bumping cache mem on g5s by +1GB. Filing a short follow-up.

Maria: Blockers: waiting on quota approval from support. If not approved by EOD we'll keep more capacity routed to IAD and SYD to preserve SLAs. Also need a heads-up for any customer-facing routing changes.

Sam: Today I'm coordinating with cloud ops and will watch the prewarm rollout. I'll post an update by 10:30 UTC. Ping me if nodes fail to register in 20 minutes after apply.

Chen: Apply succeeded. New nodes registering now: `nodepool/ams-prewarm-1: ready (2)`, `nodepool/iad-prewarm-1: ready (2)`. Logs show join events and kubelet healthy.

Maria: Thanks — dashboards show free headroom ~8% in AMS after the change. Marking as green for now, will update if support case moves. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Quick follow-up: I'll attach a short graph to INFRA-492 showing core usage and a diff with the prewarm bump so we have context for the quota request.

Sam: Great — excellent coordination. If quota arrives we'll scale down IAD spots back to baseline; otherwise we'll keep this for the next 24h.

Chen: Leaving a comment in INFRA-492 with the terraform diff and the apply log.

Maria: Thanks team — I'll watch customer-facing alerts and post if anything pops.

Alex: :thumbsup:
